description: Defines classes, templates, and functions for Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithms, including parameter structures, prior distributions, likelihood calculations, and update methods, within the 'slide' namespace.

classes.name: MCMC_Input
classes.description: Template struct representing MCMC input parameters and logR values, with methods for scaling and element access.

classes.name: MCMCSettings
classes.description: Template struct holding initial parameters, scalar, distribution parameters, and iteration count for MCMC.

classes.name: Prior
classes.description: Template class representing a prior distribution over parameters, with evaluation method.

classes.name: MCMC_Record
classes.description: Template struct combining input parameters and likelihood results for MCMC sampling history.

methods.name: S_update
methods.description: Updates the proposal covariance matrix S based on weights w, alpha, and n, using adaptive algorithms.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales the parameter vector by a scalar array.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses parameter or logR elements by index, with bounds checking.

methods.name: get_R
methods.description: Returns the exponential of the first logR element.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Evaluates the prior probability for a given parameter vector.

methods.name: LL
methods.description: Calculates the log-likelihood and prior probability for a candidate parameter set.
